bagPolicy.summary: The official basketball A–Z guide says the SEC clear-bag policy applies at all events in Humphrey Coliseum; medically necessary nonclear bags are screened at any entrance. Consult the linked clear-bag details and any concert announcement before bringing a bag.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The basketball guide lists limited $5 public parking east of Dudy Noble Field off Lakeview Drive and free lots at Zacharias Village, Barnes & Noble, Bost Extension Center, Memorial Hall and Garner Hall. These are basketball arrangements; concert parking may differ.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The guide identifies a vehicle drop-off lane on Lakeview Drive on the east side of the Coliseum, but does not designate a rideshare pickup zone.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The basketball A–Z guide prohibits outside food and drink but does not publish specific concession offerings for concerts.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The guide lists accessible seating in Sections 101, 103, 107, 109, 111, 113, 116 and 119; elevators are behind Section 111 and in Mize Pavilion. Contact the ticket office in advance for accommodations.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Coliseum guide says there are no pass-outs or re-entry without purchasing a new ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The athletics ticket office and will call are in the east lobby and open 90 minutes before basketball tip-off; a concert pickup time is not listed.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The guide states basketball gates open 90 minutes before tip-off, with security screening at each entrance. It does not give a universal concert opening time.
